import gurobipy as gp
import json

I = range(3)
T = range(8)
names = ["P1", "P2", "P3"]

S = [22, 18, 25]
F = [18, 15, 20]
a = [2, 3, 1]
L = [24, 20, 28]
U = [82, 70, 90]
setup_cost = [52, 60, 45]
h = [1.2, 1.6, 0.9]

D = [
    [34,48,42,55,38,50,46,40],
    [28,32,45,36,50,34,42,39],
    [40,35,38,44,36,48,41,45]
]

PC = [
    [5,8,5,8,5,8,5,8],
    [7,10,7,10,7,10,7,10],
    [9,6,9,6,9,6,9,6]
]

H = [250,245,235,260,240,255,245,265]

m = gp.Model("L02")
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0

x = m.addVars(I, T, vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, name="x")
y = m.addVars(I, T, vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name="y")
s = m.addVars(I, T, vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=75, name="s")

for i in I:
    for t in T:
        prev = S[i] if t == 0 else s[i, t-1]
        m.addConstr(s[i, t] == prev + x[i, t] - D[i][t], name=f"bal_{names[i]}_{t+1}")
        m.addConstr(x[i, t] >= L[i] * y[i, t], name=f"lotmin_{names[i]}_{t+1}")
        m.addConstr(x[i, t] <= U[i] * y[i, t], name=f"lotmax_{names[i]}_{t+1}")
    m.addConstr(s[i, 7] >= F[i], name=f"final_{names[i]}")

for t in T:
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(s[i, t] for i in I) <= 150, name=f"inv_tot_{t+1}")
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(a[i] * x[i, t] for i in I) <= H[t], name=f"cap_{t+1}")

m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(y[i, t] for
